correctness.rationale: For the Artin–Schreier cover y^2+y=x^9+omega, the unique pole of odd order 9 gives genus 4. The trace criterion shows no affine points over F4 or F64, so N1=N3=1 and B3=(N3-N1)/3=0. Proposition 2.2 of Aubry–Herbaut–Monaldi gives rho(4,4)<=4 because 3<4 log_4(1+sqrt(8))<4. The explicit witness gives rho(4,4)>=4, hence equality. The included finite-field script independently checks the trace computations.
